name: fal.ai
verified: Endpoint slug, per-second price, 15s cap and the video field names were checked against fal.ai on 2026-09-04, and image/cutout/video were all run live. duration must be a STRING enum ('4'..'15' or 'auto'); a float is rejected with 422. Note that fal reports such a failure as status COMPLETED in the queue - the refusal only appears when you fetch the response. Reference endpoints added 2026-09-05 from fal's docs: nano-banana-pro/edit takes image_urls (up to 14, $0.15/image, 4K at 2x); seedance reference-to-video takes image_urls (up to 9) and the prompt addresses them as [Image1], [Image2]. Data URIs are PROVEN on seedance image-to-video but UNDOCUMENTED on /edit - if a call is rejected for the input format, an upload step is needed rather than inlining.

pricing.note: Seedance 2.0 Fast at 720p; $0.2419/s and the 15s cap confirmed 2026-09-04. Standard tier ~$0.3024/s. Rates drift - verify at https://fal.ai/pricing before budgeting.
